prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit cinematic cel-shaded narrative,1536x1024 landscape. First portraits establish fixed canonical identities, facial morphology and age, eyes/nose/jaw, hair, costume and equipment. Next approved room master for ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not diagrams or colors. Last reference exact restaging target. Restrained clean outlines and muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal/navy, natural skin, modest practical lights. No glossy or neon lime. Balanced stylized adults with coherent neck/shoulders/torso, plausible arm chains, exactly two five-finger hands each, natural chair/table support. Faces visible, eyes follow work or other crew, candid action and subtle lively emotion, no camera gaze or presentation portrait. Screens physically face actual reader; camera beside reader sees same front face. Every label, cell, line, arrow follows correct surface perspective. Remove outward handheld displays. Peripheral screens inactive. Only specified content, no fake numerical findings or extra diagrams. Farah LEFT and Demir RIGHT seated shoulder to shoulder checking input-target windows on a shared lab console. Demir is typing with natural hands; Farah leans slightly toward his screen, hands resting gently on desk, eyes on his work with pleased smile. Demir glances toward her with relieved playful smile, no extreme neck turn. Remove handheld tablets. Upright shared monitor at LEFT foreground faces both, camera same lit side. Exact screen heading "Worked practice pairs". Two lines "[1,2,3] -> [4]" and "[2,3,4] -> [5]". Clearly label "Input window" over left side and "Next target" over right. Beneath "xs [2,3,1]" and "windows, steps, features"; then "ys [2,1]" and "windows, features". Footer "Split before windowing". No checkmarks or invented trainedscore. All content one monitor perspective, no flat overlays.
